dimensions.source: Erlich et al., Science 2018, Identity inference of genomic data using long-range familial searches
dimensions.limitations: Approximately 60 percent of searches in a dataset of 1.28 million consumer-genomics individuals returned a relative sharing at least 100 cM, typically corresponding to a third cousin or closer. This score represents demonstrated familial reach under the study population and database conditions; it is not a 60 percent probability of complete individual re-identification and should not be generalized across ancestries or database compositions.
